venture.name: Hockey Bag with Built-in Stick Holders
venture.concept: A proposed ice-hockey equipment bag with holders for at least two sticks, intended to reduce the number of loose items players and families carry to the rink.
venture.product: Full-size hockey equipment bag with built-in external stick holders for at least two sticks.
venture.targetCustomers: Youth players, mainly ages 6–20, and parents or caregivers who influence or make equipment purchases.
venture.valueProposition: Carry hockey gear and sticks together in fewer trips, with more convenient transport to the rink and team travel.
venture.market: North America, Europe, and Russia are named in the venture materials. For this cost model, a North American direct-to-consumer launch is an explicit working assumption, consistent with the Mission 1 recommendation to validate North America first.
venture.distributionAssumption: Direct-to-consumer online sales with home-based early fulfillment. The venture workspace does not specify a sales channel, manufacturing partner, final dimensions, or product cost.
features: Proposed integrated holders for at least two sticks
unprovenClaims: Final materials, dimensions, gear capacity, comfort, durability, and product performance have not been tested or supplied.

costEvidenceSources.name: Stripe standard online card pricing
costEvidenceSources.observation: Displayed 2.9% + $0.30 per successful domestic card transaction. The model assumes one bag in each transaction; actual processing method, geography, negotiated fees, refunds, and tax treatment can differ.

costEvidenceSources.name: Uline 36 x 18 x 18 inch 200 lb corrugated box
costEvidenceSources.observation: Displayed $7.08 per box at the 15-unit quantity tier. The reference size is close to, but not validated against, a hockey equipment bag. Freight, taxes, minimum quantities, and final packaging fit are not included.

costEvidenceSources.name: Connecticut domestic LLC formation fee
costEvidenceSources.source_type: Official Connecticut Secretary of the State filing fee
costEvidenceSources.observation: Displayed $120 Certificate of Organization fee. Only relevant if the venture forms a Connecticut LLC; other jurisdictions and business structures differ.

costEvidenceSources.name: Connecticut domestic LLC annual report fee
costEvidenceSources.source_type: Official Connecticut Secretary of the State filing fee
costEvidenceSources.observation: Displayed $80 online annual report fee for a Connecticut LLC. Conditional on using that entity and jurisdiction.

costEvidenceSources.name: USPS Ground Advantage postage information
costEvidenceSources.observation: Postage depends on package weight, dimensions, service, distance/zone, and purchase method. The dashboard's $18 starting value is illustrative, not a USPS quote; enter a quote for the actual prototype and route.

costEvidenceSources.name: GitHub Pages availability and pricing eligibility
costEvidenceSources.observation: GitHub documents Pages availability for public repositories on GitHub Free. The $0 hosting assumption is limited to a public static informational site and excludes checkout, custom-domain, commerce, and other third-party service charges.

suggestedExpenses.name: Bag manufacturing and assembly
suggestedExpenses.description: Supplier-made bag body, stick-holder construction, assembly, and basic production labor per finished bag.
suggestedExpenses.referenceText: No supplier quote or bill of materials was supplied. $45 is an illustrative planning placeholder only; obtain prototype and production quotes.
suggestedExpenses.assumptions: Early small-batch production; excludes tooling and one-time sample costs below. Replace with written supplier quotes.

suggestedExpenses.description: One shipping carton plus basic protective packing per shipped bag.

suggestedExpenses.assumptions: Assumes one bag per transaction. If multiple bags share one checkout, allocate the transaction fee across those units.
